posts.title: Fixing AWS Lightsail crashing after a few hours
posts.description: A persistent and annoying issue affects Amazon Web Services (AWS) Lightsail instances: they shut down seemingly randomly after only a few hours. The instance seems fine for an hour or two, then suddenly shuts itself down.
